agent_annotation.reason: The frozen synthetic test failed the p95 and per-family signed-offset precision gates. Real-frame agent passes, consensus, and adjudication were therefore not run.

expansion_decision.reason: The core set covers clean, occluded, tight/graphics, and logo-heavy views and is sufficient to establish the baseline. The three locked additions remain available only if a later hybrid comparison is borderline or demonstrates a coverage gap.

limitations: The benchmark has six deliberately selected frames from three clips and is exploratory, not a production accuracy claim.
The reference was created by one human labeler and has not received an independent second-person audit.
Only five frames have scoreable baseline transforms; one refusal is retained as an unscored coverage result.
The far-depth band contains only six annotation samples, so its error estimates are directional rather than stable population statistics.
